## Notes

- Simple Axis Naval Convoy Bombing Chart (SPI 32.66, Abstract Logistics): for the convoy route in use, read down that route's column until the westernmost hex column beyond which a qualifying Commonwealth division stands (a complete, non-shell division east of, or in, that column); the row's bomb-point band is the Air Bombardment CRT column the attack is resolved on. A threshold is a map sheet letter plus an east-west column (the chart's 'xx' means any north-south row); a dash means the band cannot be reached on that route
- On the Axis player's chart set (jp2 176), not the shared sheet. Transcribed from the archive.org scan and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan (scan:discord:Axis Charts.pdf:p34): 0 of 60 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no charts
